evidence.reason: The alleged gap is closed at the current tip: after resolving baseSha, scripts/ratchet-propose.mjs now compares measuredSha against baseSha and, when they differ, logs that the measurement is stale and exits without proposing or branching. That is exactly the proposed fail-closed/no-op binding, so the incomplete measured-commit check no longer exists. The finding's own proposed diff is present verbatim (with a comment) in the current code.
